decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - A speed hump and bollard shall be placed on the access driveway to ensure that vehicles accessing the site avoid contact with adjacent dwellings. Further plans illustrating these details shall be submitted to Council for approval in writing within two months of consent, with the approved work being completed within three months of consent or such longer period as agreed by the Lonodn Boough of Hounslow in writing.
Condition : 2 - The permission shall be for a limited period only expiring on 1st July 2002 when the use shall be discontinued.
Condition : 3 - The premises shall only be used for the purposes of servicing private cars, and no panel beating or spraying shall be carried out.
Condition : 4 - No petrol or inflammable substances shall be stored at the premises.
Condition : 5 - The permission shall be personal to Mr R A Berks and Son and shall not ensure for the benefit of the land.
description: CONTINUED USE OF GARAGE AT NUMBER 11 FOR VEHICLE SERVICING.
